mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia potentiate amiodarone's QT prolongation and increase risk of torsades de pointes arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium closely; maintain levels >4.0 mEq/L and >2.0 mg/dL respectively; consider potassium-sparing diuretic or electrolyte supplementation.
